# Effects

87 visual effects. Apply them to a clip (`clips[].effects`), a media layer (`layers[].effects`), or the whole video (`project.effects`). With Claude, use the `add_effect` tool and target a clip id, a layer id, or `"global"`.

```json
{ "type": "kenBurns", "params": { "zoomTo": 1.2, "pan": "right" } }
```

Parameters you omit take their defaults. Each effect compiles to an FFmpeg filter chain ([engine/library/effects/index.ts](../../engine/library/effects/index.ts)). Register your own with `registerEffect`.

## Color

### adjust

**Adjust**. Basic color correction: brightness, contrast, saturation, gamma.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `brightness` | number |  | `0` | -1..1, 0 = unchanged (≥ -1, ≤ 1) |
| `contrast` | number |  | `1` | 1 = unchanged (≥ 0, ≤ 3) |
| `saturation` | number |  | `1` | 1 = unchanged, 0 = grayscale (≥ 0, ≤ 3) |
| `gamma` | number |  | `1` | 1 = unchanged (≥ 0.1, ≤ 3) |

### temperature

**Temperature**. White balance. Lower kelvin = warmer, higher = cooler.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `kelvin` | number |  | `6500` | Color temperature in kelvin (6500 = neutral) (≥ 1000, ≤ 40000) |

### grayscale

**Black & White**. Remove all color.

_No parameters._

### sepia

**Sepia**. Old-photo brown tone.

_No parameters._

### invert

### color

**Color (all controls)**. Full color panel in one effect: exposure, contrast, highlights/shadows/whites/blacks, brilliance, temperature/tint, saturation, vibrance, per-color HSL, tone curves, color wheels, fade, clarity, sharpen, vignette, grain, auto-correct. Use one per clip and tweak values together.

### autoCorrect

**Auto Correct**. Automatic levels and white balance: stretches contrast and neutralizes color casts.

_No parameters._

### colorMatch

**Color Match**. Makes a shot look like a reference shot or still: lightness, color cast, saturation and hue moved together as one color transfer (or per-channel curves), fitted from the colors of both. Set up by match_color and grade_scene, which measure the shots and pick the method that matches best; it goes last on the clip.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `method` | "transfer" \| "reinhard" \| "curves" |  | `"transfer"` | How the match was fitted (see grade_scene) |
| `transfer` | { lightness, matrix, from, to, skin } |  |  | transfer and reinhard: the color transfer in Oklab |
| `transfer.lightness` | unknown[][] | yes |  | Oklab lightness curve as [in, out] points, inputs increasing from 0 to 1 |
| `transfer.matrix` | unknown[] | yes |  | 2x2 map of the Oklab a and b plane (row-major), around `from` |
| `transfer.from` | unknown[] | yes |  | Center of the shot's colors in Oklab a, b |
| `transfer.to` | unknown[] | yes |  | Where that center goes |
| `transfer.skin` | { hue, width, rotate } |  |  | Turns skin hues back onto the skin line |
| `transfer.skin.hue` | number | yes |  | Oklab hue of the skin after the transfer, degrees |
| `transfer.skin.width` | number | yes |  | How far around that hue the correction reaches, degrees (> 0) |
| `transfer.skin.rotate` | number | yes |  | Hue turn applied there, degrees |
| `curves` | { master, red, green, blue, preset } |  |  | curves: per-channel curves |
| `curves.master` | unknown[][] |  |  | Curve points [input, output] in 0..1, e.g. [[0,0],[0.25,0.2],[0.75,0.8],[1,1]] for an S-curve |
| `curves.red` | unknown[][] |  |  | Curve points [input, output] in 0..1, e.g. [[0,0],[0.25,0.2],[0.75,0.8],[1,1]] for an S-curve |
| `curves.green` | unknown[][] |  |  | Curve points [input, output] in 0..1, e.g. [[0,0],[0.25,0.2],[0.75,0.8],[1,1]] for an S-curve |
| `curves.blue` | unknown[][] |  |  | Curve points [input, output] in 0..1, e.g. [[0,0],[0.25,0.2],[0.75,0.8],[1,1]] for an S-curve |
| `curves.preset` | "increase_contrast" \| "medium_contrast" \| "strong_contrast" \| "linear_contrast" \| "lighter" \| "darker" \| "vintage" \| "cross_process" \| "color_negative" \| "negative" |  |  | Built-in curve shape (applied before custom points) |
| `reference` | string |  |  | The clip or image matched to, for the record |

### curves

**Tone Curves**. Tone curve graphs: master and per-channel red/green/blue curves as [input, output] points in 0..1, or a preset shape.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `master` | unknown[][] |  |  | Curve points [input, output] in 0..1, e.g. [[0,0],[0.25,0.2],[0.75,0.8],[1,1]] for an S-curve |
| `red` | unknown[][] |  |  | Curve points [input, output] in 0..1, e.g. [[0,0],[0.25,0.2],[0.75,0.8],[1,1]] for an S-curve |
| `green` | unknown[][] |  |  | Curve points [input, output] in 0..1, e.g. [[0,0],[0.25,0.2],[0.75,0.8],[1,1]] for an S-curve |
| `blue` | unknown[][] |  |  | Curve points [input, output] in 0..1, e.g. [[0,0],[0.25,0.2],[0.75,0.8],[1,1]] for an S-curve |
| `preset` | "increase_contrast" \| "medium_contrast" \| "strong_contrast" \| "linear_contrast" \| "lighter" \| "darker" \| "vintage" \| "cross_process" \| "color_negative" \| "negative" |  |  | Built-in curve shape (applied before custom points) |

### colorWheels

**Color Wheels**. Color grading wheels: tint shadows, midtones and highlights separately, each with a hue (0..360) and amount (0..100). Teal shadows + orange highlights is the classic film look.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `shadows` | { hue, amount } |  |  |  |
| `shadows.hue` | number | yes |  | Tint direction in degrees: 0 red, 30 orange, 60 yellow, 120 green, 180 cyan, 210 teal-blue, 240 blue, 300 magenta (≥ 0, ≤ 360) |
| `shadows.amount` | number | yes |  | Tint strength 0..100 (≥ 0, ≤ 100) |
| `midtones` | { hue, amount } |  |  |  |
| `midtones.hue` | number | yes |  | Tint direction in degrees: 0 red, 30 orange, 60 yellow, 120 green, 180 cyan, 210 teal-blue, 240 blue, 300 magenta (≥ 0, ≤ 360) |
| `midtones.amount` | number | yes |  | Tint strength 0..100 (≥ 0, ≤ 100) |
| `highlights` | { hue, amount } |  |  |  |
| `highlights.hue` | number | yes |  | Tint direction in degrees: 0 red, 30 orange, 60 yellow, 120 green, 180 cyan, 210 teal-blue, 240 blue, 300 magenta (≥ 0, ≤ 360) |
| `highlights.amount` | number | yes |  | Tint strength 0..100 (≥ 0, ≤ 100) |

| `threshold` | number |  | `45` | Only parts brighter than this glow (≥ 0, ≤ 100) |
| `radius` | number |  | `30` | Glow spread (≥ 1, ≤ 100) |

### lightRays

**Light Rays / God Rays**. Shafts of light streaming out from a bright source: sun through trees, clouds or a window, a stage light, headlights in haze. The parts of the picture brighter than threshold are smeared outward from the source point and added back as light, so rays only come from real highlights and are broken up by whatever blocks them. Put the source on the light itself (inside the frame or on its edge). Pair with dust motes in the beams (add_particles dust) and a lens flare (add_light flare).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | number |  | `0.5` | Source x (frame fraction), on the light (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |
| `y` | number |  | `0.2` | Source y (frame fraction) (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |
| `threshold` | number |  | `0.7` | Only parts brighter than this cast rays (lower for dimmer sources) (≥ 0, ≤ 0.98) |
| `length` | number |  | `0.5` | How far the rays reach toward the frame edges (≥ 0.05, ≤ 1) |
| `intensity` | number |  | `0.8` | Brightness of the rays (≥ 0, ≤ 3) |
| `color` | string |  | `"#FFE6B8"` | Ray tint #RRGGBB (warm sunlight by default) |

### bokehLights

**Floating Bokeh Lights**. Soft out-of-focus light orbs of different sizes drifting slowly upward over the picture. Romantic, festive or dreamy openers, weddings, night scenes and title backgrounds.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `count` | integer |  | `12` | Number of orbs (≥ 1, ≤ 30) |
| `size` | number |  | `30` | Orb size (≥ 1, ≤ 100) |
| `speed` | number |  | `25` | How fast they drift upward (≥ 0, ≤ 100) |
| `color` | string |  | `"#FFD8A0"` | Light color #RRGGBB (warm gold by default) |
| `opacity` | number |  | `0.6` | Overall strength (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |

### lightLeak

**Light Leak**. Warm film light leaks washing slowly across the frame from the edges. Nostalgic, vintage, summer and wedding looks.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `color` | string |  | `"#FF7A2E"` | Leak color #RRGGBB |
| `opacity` | number |  | `0.45` | Strength (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |
| `speed` | number |  | `30` | How fast the leaks move (≥ 0, ≤ 100) |

### flashHits

**Flash Hits**. Quick white (or colored-feel) flashes at chosen moments that fade out, e.g. on beats, cuts or impacts. Use add_moment_effect or beat_sync to place them.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `times` | number[] |  | `[0]` | Moments, in seconds from the start of the clip or layer it is on (add_moment_effect and beat_sync fill these from timeline times) |
| `strength` | number |  | `0.6` | Brightness of each flash (≥ 0.05, ≤ 1) |
| `decay` | number |  | `8` | How fast each flash fades (higher = shorter) (≥ 1, ≤ 40) |

### strobe

**Strobe / Flicker**. Rhythmic strobe flashes (club, music video) or an irregular old-film flicker.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | "strobe" \| "flicker" |  | `"strobe"` |  |
| `rate` | number |  | `8` | Flashes per second (strobe) (≥ 0.5, ≤ 30) |
| `strength` | number |  | `0.35` | Brightness change (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |

### clarity

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | number |  | `0` | (≥ -100, ≤ 100) |

| `strength` | number |  | `0.5` | 0..1 (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |

### custom

**Custom**. Your own effect as an FFmpeg filter chain (comma-separated filters for one stream), for looks the catalog does not have: e.g. 'geq=r=...:g=...:b=...' per-pixel math with X, Y, W, H, T, 'rgbashift=rh=6:bh=-6,noise=alls=12:allf=t' for a glitch, 'lagfun=decay=0.95' for light trails, 'lenscorrection=k1=-0.3:k2=0.05' for a fisheye. Allowed filters: eq, hue, curves, colorbalance, colorchannelmixer, colorlevels, colortemperature, colorcontrast, colorcorrect, colorize, vibrance, selectivecolor, huesaturation, exposure, lutrgb, lutyuv, lut, negate, monochrome, grayworld, normalize, pseudocolor, geq, gblur, boxblur, avgblur, dblur, smartblur, unsharp, cas, convolution, edgedetect, sobel, prewitt, roberts, deband, gradfun, bilateral, median, vignette, noise, chromashift, rgbashift, pixelize, elbg, posterize, kirsch, colorhold, chromakey, colorkey, hsvhold, hsvkey, lenscorrection, rotate, hflip, vflip, transpose, crop, scale, pad, perspective, shear, swaprect, v360, fillborders, tmix, lagfun, tblend, deflicker, fade, format, setsar, null. The frame size is kept. Save a good one with create_effect to reuse it by name.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `filter` | string |  | `"null"` | FFmpeg filter chain |
| `name` | string |  |  | Name of the saved effect this came from (create_effect) |

## Retouch

### beauty

**Beauty / Skin Retouch**. Portrait retouch: edge-preserving skin smoothing that keeps eyes, hair and outlines sharp, plus optional brightening and warmth. Applies to the whole frame, only inside a face region (x, y, width, height as frame fractions; check placement with render_frame), or, with followFace, only on the faces wherever they move (found on every frame of primary video clips).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `smooth` | number |  | `50` | Skin smoothing strength (≥ 0, ≤ 100) |
| `brighten` | number |  | `15` | Lift and even out skin tones (≥ 0, ≤ 100) |
| `warmth` | number |  | `10` | + warmer, healthier skin, - cooler (≥ -100, ≤ 100) |
| `region` | { x, y, width, height } |  |  | Only retouch inside this ellipse (the face); omit for the whole frame |
| `region.x` | number | yes |  | Center x (0 = left edge, 1 = right edge) (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |
| `region.y` | number | yes |  | Center y (0 = top, 1 = bottom) (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |
| `region.width` | number | yes |  | Ellipse width as a fraction of frame width (> 0, ≤ 2) |
| `region.height` | number | yes |  | Ellipse height as a fraction of frame height (> 0, ≤ 2) |
| `followFace` | boolean |  | `false` | Retouch only the faces, following them frame by frame (primary video clips; elsewhere region applies) |

### backgroundBlur

**Background Blur / Portrait Mode**. Keep the subject sharp and blur everything around it, like a portrait-mode lens. With cutout, the person's real outline is found on every frame (on primary clips) and followed as they move; otherwise an ellipse (x, y = its center, width, height as frame fractions) stays sharp. A larger feather gives a softer, more natural edge.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `amount` | number |  | `25` | Background blur strength (≥ 1, ≤ 100) |
| `cutout` | boolean |  | `false` | Follow the person's outline, found automatically on each frame (primary clips); the ellipse is used elsewhere |
| `subject` | { x, y, width, height } |  | `{"x":0.5,"y":0.45,"width":0.6,"height":0.7}` | Ellipse around the subject that stays sharp |
| `subject.x` | number | yes |  | Center x (0 = left edge, 1 = right edge) (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |
| `subject.y` | number | yes |  | Center y (0 = top, 1 = bottom) (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |
| `subject.width` | number | yes |  | Ellipse width as a fraction of frame width (> 0, ≤ 2) |
| `subject.height` | number | yes |  | Ellipse height as a fraction of frame height (> 0, ≤ 2) |
| `feather` | number |  | `0.35` | Softness of the subject edge (≥ 0.02, ≤ 1) |
| `dim` | number |  | `0` | Also darken the background (0 = no change) (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |

### backgroundReplace

**Replace Background**. Put a solid color behind the person, like a virtual backdrop: the person's outline is found on every frame of primary clips (no green screen needed). Elsewhere the ellipse is kept instead. Best on one or two people in front of a plain-ish scene.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `color` | string |  | `"#101216"` | Backdrop color, #RRGGBB |
| `mix` | number |  | `1` | How much of the backdrop replaces the scene (0.7 leaves a hint of it) (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |
| `subject` | { x, y, width, height } |  | `{"x":0.5,"y":0.45,"width":0.6,"height":0.7}` | Ellipse kept when there is no cutout |
| `subject.x` | number | yes |  | Center x (0 = left edge, 1 = right edge) (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |
| `subject.y` | number | yes |  | Center y (0 = top, 1 = bottom) (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |
| `subject.width` | number | yes |  | Ellipse width as a fraction of frame width (> 0, ≤ 2) |
| `subject.height` | number | yes |  | Ellipse height as a fraction of frame height (> 0, ≤ 2) |
| `feather` | number |  | `0.25` | Softness of the person's edge (≥ 0.02, ≤ 1) |

### skyReplace

**Replace Sky**. Put a new sky (an image or video asset, or a gradient) where the sky is, found by a model on every frame of primary clips. The new sky moves with the camera, is softened to the scene's sharpness, gets the scene's horizon haze, and the scenery is tinted slightly toward it. Use replace_sky, which measures the camera motion and colors and sets this up; check the edge with render_frame where trees or buildings meet the sky.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `asset` | string |  |  | Image or video asset of the new sky; omit for a gradient |
| `colors` | unknown[] |  | `["#3E7FD8","#A9CAEC"]` | Gradient top and bottom colors, used when there is no asset |
| `focus` | { x, y } |  | `{"x":0.5,"y":0.5}` | Which part of the new sky picture shows when it is cropped to the frame (0 = left or top edge, 1 = right or bottom) |
| `focus.x` | number | yes |  | (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |
| `focus.y` | number | yes |  | (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |
| `motion` | { time, x, y, scale, angle }[] |  | `[]` | The camera's motion, so the sky moves with the scene (replace_sky measures it) |
| `cover` | number |  | `1.1` | How much larger than the frame the new sky is drawn, so moving it never shows its edges (replace_sky sets it from the motion) (≥ 1, ≤ 3) |
| `gain` | number |  | `1` | Brightness of the new sky (replace_sky matches it to the old sky's) (≥ 0.25, ≤ 4) |
| `blur` | number |  | `0.6` | Soften the new sky to the scene's sharpness, in pixels at 1080p (≥ 0, ≤ 20) |
| `haze` | number |  | `0.35` | Horizon haze: the scene's horizon color over the new sky, fading up from the scenery (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |
| `hazeColor` | string |  | `"#C8D3DE"` | Haze color (replace_sky uses the new sky's lowest part, paler) |
| `hazeHeight` | number |  | `0.1` | How far up the haze reaches, as a fraction of frame height (≥ 0.01, ≤ 0.5) |
| `relight` | number |  | `0.12` | Tint the scenery toward the new sky's color, so it seems lit by it (0.1 is subtle) (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |
| `lightColor` | string |  | `"#9DB7D9"` | The new sky's color, for relight (replace_sky measures it) |
| `edge` | number |  | `0.001` | Grow the new sky over the scenery's outline by this fraction of frame height (at least a pixel), covering the old sky that edge pixels still hold; negative shrinks it, 0 leaves the matte as found (≥ -0.02, ≤ 0.02) |
| `feather` | number |  | `0.0015` | Edge softness as a fraction of frame height (≥ 0, ≤ 0.05) |

### maskView

**Mask View**. Shows a mask in place of an effect, white on black (matte) or as a red tint over the picture (overlay), to check what the mask selects. render_mask uses it; it does not belong in a finished edit.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mask` | { kind, object, hue, saturation, luma, softness, shape, invert, feather, grow, smooth, denoise, combine } |  | `{"kind":"shape","softness":0.2,"shape":{"type":"ellipse","x":0.5,"y":0.5,"width":0.5,"height":0.5},"invert":false,"feather":0.01,"grow":0,"smooth":0,"denoise":false}` | Limits an effect to part of the frame. Check it with render_mask before relying on it |
| `mask.kind` | "person" \| "face" \| "object" \| "sky" \| "key" \| "luma" \| "shape" | yes |  | person = the person's cutout, face = soft ellipses following every face, object = a tracked object from select_object, sky = the sky, found by a model (all four found per frame; primary video clips only), key = an HSL qualifier on hue, saturation and luma ranges, luma = a brightness range only, shape = a fixed ellipse or rectangle |
| `mask.object` | string |  |  | object: the id of a tracked object (project.objects, made with select_object) |
| `mask.hue` | unknown[] |  |  | key: hue range in degrees, going clockwise from the first to the second, so [340, 20] selects reds. 0 red, 30 orange, 60 yellow, 120 green, 180 cyan, 210 sky blue, 240 blue, 300 magenta; skin is about [5, 45]. Omit for any hue |
| `mask.saturation` | unknown[] |  |  | key: saturation range 0..1 (HSV); [0.15, 1] skips grays, whose hue is unreliable. Omit for any |
| `mask.luma` | unknown[] |  |  | key and luma: brightness range 0..1, e.g. [0.7, 1] for highlights, [0, 0.25] for shadows. Omit for any |
| `mask.softness` | number |  | `0.2` | key and luma: how gradually the ranges fall off at their ends (0 = hard edge) (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |
| `mask.shape` | { type, x, y, width, height } |  |  | shape: the area, fixed for the whole clip |
| `mask.shape.type` | "ellipse" \| "rect" |  | `"ellipse"` |  |
| `mask.shape.x` | number | yes |  | Center x as a frame fraction (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |
| `mask.shape.y` | number | yes |  | Center y as a frame fraction (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |
| `mask.shape.width` | number | yes |  | Width as a fraction of frame width (> 0, ≤ 2) |
| `mask.shape.height` | number | yes |  | Height as a fraction of frame height (> 0, ≤ 2) |
| `mask.invert` | boolean |  | `false` | Select everything except this |
| `mask.feather` | number |  | `0.01` | Edge softness as a fraction of frame height (0.01 is subtle, 0.05 very soft) (≥ 0, ≤ 0.2) |
| `mask.grow` | number |  | `0` | Grow (+) or shrink (-) the selection by a fraction of frame height (≥ -0.05, ≤ 0.05) |
| `mask.smooth` | integer |  | `0` | Average the matte over this many frames to stop flicker (0 = off) (≥ 0, ≤ 10) |
| `mask.denoise` | boolean |  | `false` | key and luma: clean speckles from noisy footage with a small median |
| `mask.combine` | { kind, object, hue, saturation, luma, softness, shape, invert, op }[] |  |  | More masks merged into this one, in order, e.g. a key intersected with a shape |
| `style` | "matte" \| "overlay" |  | `"matte"` |  |

### denoise

**Denoise**. Remove grain and color noise from dim or phone footage, keeping edges. strength 0.3 is light, 0.6 cleans low-light video, 1 is heavy (skin and texture start to smear). Pair with the denoise audio effect for hiss.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `strength` | number |  | `0.5` | 0..1 (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |

### blur

### sharpen

**Sharpen**. Increase detail.

### bokeh

**Bokeh / Lens Blur**. Out-of-focus lens blur where points of light become soft discs (bokeh), unlike a plain blur. Use on night lights, city backgrounds or b-roll behind titles. Give a subject ellipse to keep a person sharp in front of a bokeh background.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |

| `amount` | number |  | `40` | Disc size / defocus strength (≥ 1, ≤ 100) |
| `highlights` | number |  | `50` | Make bright spots bloom into brighter discs (≥ 0, ≤ 100) |
| `subject` | { x, y, width, height } |  |  | Ellipse that stays sharp (x, y center, width, height as frame fractions); omit to defocus the whole frame |
| `subject.x` | number | yes |  | Center x (0 = left edge, 1 = right edge) (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |
| `subject.y` | number | yes |  | Center y (0 = top, 1 = bottom) (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |
| `subject.width` | number | yes |  | Ellipse width as a fraction of frame width (> 0, ≤ 2) |
| `subject.height` | number | yes |  | Ellipse height as a fraction of frame height (> 0, ≤ 2) |
| `feather` | number |  | `0.35` | Softness of the subject edge (≥ 0.02, ≤ 1) |

### zoomBlur

**Zoom Blur**. Radial blur streaking out from a point, like zooming the lens during exposure. Pairs well with zoomPunch and whoosh sound effects for energetic moments.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `amount` | number |  | `40` | Streak length (≥ 1, ≤ 100) |
| `x` | number |  | `0.5` | Center x (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |
| `y` | number |  | `0.5` | Center y (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |

### rackFocus

**Rack Focus / Focus Pull**. Animate focus: start blurred and pull into sharp focus (direction in), or drift out of focus (direction out), over a time window in the clip. A classic opener or scene ending.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `direction` | "in" \| "out" |  | `"in"` | in = blurred to sharp, out = sharp to blurred |
| `start` | number |  | `0` | Seconds from the clip start when the focus change begins (≥ 0, ≤ 3600) |
| `duration` | number |  | `1.2` | Seconds the focus change takes (≥ 0.1, ≤ 30) |
| `amount` | number |  | `30` | Blur at the blurred end (≥ 1, ≤ 100) |

### motionBlur

**Motion Blur**. Blend neighbouring frames so movement smears like a slow shutter. Smooths fast pans and sped-up footage.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `frames` | integer |  | `3` | Frames blended together (≥ 2, ≤ 8) |

## Motion

### stabilize

**Stabilize**. Steady shaky handheld footage: camera shake is measured frame to frame and cancelled, and the picture is zoomed in slightly (zoom) so the moving edges stay out of frame. Best on small jitters; it does not straighten big pans. Put it on the clip (each clip is stabilized on its own).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `zoom` | number |  | `1.08` | Crop-in that hides the edges; raise it if borders show (≥ 1, ≤ 1.3) |
| `range` | number |  | `48` | Largest shake corrected, in pixels (≥ 8, ≤ 64) |

### kenBurns

**Ken Burns**. Slow zoom (in or out) with optional pan. Great for photos and static shots.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `zoomFrom` | number |  | `1` | Start zoom (1 = no zoom) (≥ 1, ≤ 3) |
| `zoomTo` | number |  | `1.2` | End zoom (≥ 1, ≤ 3) |
| `pan` | "center" \| "left" \| "right" \| "up" \| "down" |  | `"center"` |  |

### zoom

**Static Zoom / Crop In**. Punch into the frame by a fixed amount (reframe a shot).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `scale` | number |  | `1.2` | Zoom factor (≥ 1, ≤ 4) |
| `x` | number |  | `0.5` | Focus point x (0..1) (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |
| `y` | number |  | `0.5` | Focus point y (0..1) (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |

### punchIn

**Punch-In Zooms**. Alternate between normal and zoomed framing every few seconds, the classic talking-head jump-zoom that keeps viewers engaged.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `interval` | number |  | `3` | Seconds between zoom changes (≥ 0.5, ≤ 30) |
| `scale` | number |  | `1.15` | Zoom factor when punched in (≥ 1.01, ≤ 2) |

### pulse

**Beat Pulse**. Rhythmic zoom pulse, e.g. on a music beat.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bpm` | number |  | `120` | Beats per minute (≥ 30, ≤ 240) |
| `amount` | number |  | `0.06` | Zoom added on each beat (≥ 0.01, ≤ 0.5) |

### smoothZoom

**Smooth Zoom (Push In / Pull Out)**. Eased zoom between two framings over a time window: a slow push-in for emphasis, a fast crash zoom (short duration), or a pull-out reveal (to < from). Times are seconds from the clip start; x, y is the point to zoom toward.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | number |  | `1` | Zoom at the start (1 = full frame) (≥ 1, ≤ 4) |
| `to` | number |  | `1.3` | Zoom at the end (≥ 1, ≤ 4) |
| `start` | number |  | `0` | Seconds from the clip start when the zoom begins (≥ 0, ≤ 3600) |
| `duration` | number |  | `2` | Seconds the zoom takes (≥ 0.05, ≤ 3600) |
| `easing` | "linear" \| "ease-in" \| "ease-out" \| "ease-in-out" |  | `"ease-in-out"` |  |
| `x` | number |  | `0.5` | Zoom toward this x (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |
| `y` | number |  | `0.5` | Zoom toward this y (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |

### zoomPunch

**Zoom Punch**. Snap zoom-in hits that spring back, at chosen moments: emphasis on a key word, a beat drop, a joke landing. Use add_moment_effect or beat_sync to place them on the timeline.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `times` | number[] |  | `[0]` | Moments, in seconds from the start of the clip or layer it is on (add_moment_effect and beat_sync fill these from timeline times) |
| `amount` | number |  | `0.15` | Extra zoom at the peak of each hit (≥ 0.02, ≤ 1) |
| `decay` | number |  | `5` | How fast it springs back (higher = snappier) (≥ 0.5, ≤ 30) |
| `x` | number |  | `0.5` | Zoom toward this x (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |
| `y` | number |  | `0.5` | Zoom toward this y (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |

### heartbeat

**Heartbeat Pulse**. Double zoom pulse like a heartbeat (lub-dub). Suspense, romance, tension.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bpm` | number |  | `70` | Heartbeats per minute (≥ 30, ≤ 180) |
| `amount` | number |  | `0.05` | Zoom on each beat (≥ 0.01, ≤ 0.3) |

## Distort

### mirror

**Flip**. Flip horizontally or vertically.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `direction` | "horizontal" \| "vertical" |  | `"horizontal"` |  |

### chromaKey

**Green Screen / Chroma Key**. Key out a green (or blue) screen: put a picture behind the subject (backdrop: a set, a stage, a place, an image or video asset), replace it with a solid color to draw a UI or label on (phone screens, monitors), or make it transparent on a media overlay so whatever is underneath shows through. Removes green spill from edges and fingers. With a backdrop, shadows the subject casts on the screen darken it (shadows), so they stand on it instead of floating. Runs at full speed: prefer it to a custom filter for any green screen work.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `color` | string |  | `"#00FF00"` | Screen color to remove, #RRGGBB. Measure it with sample_color: real screens are rarely pure green |
| `similarity` | number |  | `0.1` | How far from the key color still counts as screen (raise slowly if green remains) (≥ 0.01, ≤ 0.6) |
| `blend` | number |  | `0.04` | Edge softness (≥ 0, ≤ 0.5) |
| `replace` | string |  | `"#111216"` | Color to fill the keyed area with, or "transparent" (media overlays only) |
| `backdrop` | string |  |  | Image or video asset id shown behind the subject instead of the replace color (primary clips), filling the frame |
| `shadows` | number |  | `0.7` | With a backdrop: how much shadows on the screen darken it (0 = none, 1 = as dark as on the screen) (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |

### tilt

**Dutch Tilt / Rotate**. Rotate the frame by a fixed angle and zoom just enough to hide the corners. A tilted (dutch) angle adds unease or energy.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `degrees` | number |  | `6` | Rotation, positive = clockwise (≥ -45, ≤ 45) |

## Shake

### shake

**Camera Shake**. Constant camera shake that runs for the whole clip. For a natural handheld look use handheld; for hits at moments use impactShake.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `intensity` | number |  | `10` | Max offset in pixels (≥ 1, ≤ 60) |
| `speed` | number |  | `20` | Shake frequency (≥ 1, ≤ 60) |

### handheld

**Handheld Camera**. Gentle, organic drift and sway like a camera held by hand. Makes tripod or screen footage feel alive and documentary-like.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `amount` | number |  | `30` | How much the camera wanders (≥ 1, ≤ 100) |

### vibrate

**Vibrate / Buzz**. Fast, small jitter like a phone buzzing, a bass hit or an engine rumble. Runs the whole clip, or only for `length` seconds after each of `times`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `intensity` | number |  | `6` | Jitter size in pixels (at 1080p) (≥ 1, ≤ 40) |
| `frequency` | number |  | `25` | Jitters per second (≥ 5, ≤ 60) |
| `times` | number[] |  |  | Moments, in seconds from the start of the clip or layer it is on (add_moment_effect and beat_sync fill these from timeline times) |
| `length` | number |  | `0.4` | Seconds each vibration lasts when times are given (≥ 0.05, ≤ 10) |

### earthquake

**Earthquake**. Violent, chaotic shaking with rotation: explosions, earthquakes, chaos, hype moments. Optionally builds up over time.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `intensity` | number |  | `40` | Shake size in pixels (at 1080p) (≥ 5, ≤ 120) |
| `rotation` | number |  | `2` | Max tilt in degrees (≥ 0, ≤ 10) |
| `buildUp` | number |  | `0` | Seconds to grow from nothing to full strength (≥ 0, ≤ 30) |

### impactShake

**Impact Shake**. A hard jolt that settles quickly, at chosen moments: hits, drops, slams, punchlines. Use add_moment_effect or beat_sync to place them.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `times` | number[] |  | `[0]` | Moments, in seconds from the start of the clip or layer it is on (add_moment_effect and beat_sync fill these from timeline times) |
| `intensity` | number |  | `30` | Jolt size in pixels (at 1080p) (≥ 2, ≤ 120) |
| `decay` | number |  | `7` | How fast it settles (higher = shorter) (≥ 1, ≤ 30) |

## Time

### fadeIn

**Fade In**. Fade in from black at the start.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `duration` | number |  | `0.5` | Seconds (≥ 0.05, ≤ 10) |

### fadeOut

**Fade Out**. Fade out to black at the end.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `duration` | number |  | `0.5` | Seconds (≥ 0.05, ≤ 10) |

### flash

**Flash**. Quick white flash at the start of the clip (impact moment).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `duration` | number |  | `0.25` | Seconds (≥ 0.05, ≤ 2) |
